spec.description: Errors for http requests to Search API, excluding requests containing client errors. This covers the search endpoint only.

spec.title: Search API V1 valid request error rate
spec.description: Error rate for http requests to Search API, excluding requests containing client errors. This covers just requests to the search endpoint.

spec.title: Finder Frontend valid request error rate
spec.description: Server error rate for search requests to Finder Frontend, excluding requests containing client errors. This covers requests to Search API V1 only.

spec.title: Total Finder Frontend valid request errors
spec.description: Errors for search requests to Finder Frontend, excluding requests containing client errors. This covers requests to Search API V1 only.

spec.title: Opensearch HTTP requests
spec.description: HTTP requests to our Opensearch cluster

spec.title: Search API V1 request latency: 99th percentile
spec.description:
The 99th percentile of request duration measured over a rolling 5 minute period, at various layers. 

Note that the request duration for Search API v1 only includes requests to the search endpoint, so should be directly comparable to Opensearch latency.

spec.title: Search API V1 request latency: median
spec.description:
The median request duration measured over a rolling 5 minute period, at various layers. 

Note that the request duration for Search API v1 includes requests to the search endpoint only, so should be directly comparable to Opensearch latency.

spec.title: Search API V1 error rates
spec.description: 5 minute rolling error rates for Search API V1, search endpoint only, split by error code.

spec.expr: sum by(status) (rate(http_requests_total{job="search-api", search_api_endpoint="search", status!="200"}[5m])) / ignoring(status) group_left sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="search-api", search_api_endpoint="search"}[5m]))

spec.title: Total search API V1 errors
spec.description: Total errors for all http requests to Search API, including server and client errors. This covers the search endpoint only.

spec.title: Total Search API V1 error rate
spec.description: Total error rate for all http requests to Search API, including server and client errors. This covers just requests to the search endpoint.

spec.title: Finder Frontend error rates
spec.description: 5 minute rolling errors rates for V1 search requests, split by error code.

spec.expr: sum by(status) (rate(http_requests_total{job="finder-frontend", controller="finders", search_api_version="v1", status=~"$client_error_status|$server_error_status"}[5m])) / ignoring(status) group_left sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="finder-frontend", controller="finders", search_api_version="v1"}[5m]))

spec.title: Total Finder Frontend search errors
spec.description: Total errors for search requests to Finder Frontend, including server and client errors. This covers requests to Search API V1 only.

spec.title: Finder Frontend total search error rate
spec.description: Total error rate for search requests to Finder Frontend, including server and client errors. This covers requests to Search API V1 only.

spec.title: Search API V1 request latency: 90th percentile
spec.description:
The 90th percentile of request duration measured over a rolling 5 minute period, at various layers. 

Note that the request duration for Search API v1 includes requests to the search endpoint only, so should be directly comparable to Opensearch latency.

spec.title: Search API V1 Rate of usage
spec.description:
The rate (requests per minute) of usage for Search API v1 measured over a rolling 5 minute period. 

This reflects Search API v1 requests received by Finder Frontend as well as all requests received by Search API v1. 

Note that the requests count for Search API v1 only includes requests to the search endpoint.
